reroll_token.effectText: The next shop reroll costs 1 less Gold.

coupon_stamp.effectText: The next item or Jester purchase costs 2 less Gold.

board_scrap.effectText: Gain +1 board discard for this Station.

hand_scrap.effectText: Gain +1 hand discard for this Station.

line_polish.effectText: The next confirm final score is multiplied by x1.25.

straight_oil.effectText: The next run-line confirm gains +40 Chips.

flush_powder.effectText: The next same-color confirm gains +8 Mult.

pair_splint.effectText: The next Two Pair confirm gains +35 Chips.

overlap_pin.effectText: The next confirm gets a slightly higher overlap bonus cap.

emergency_draw.effectText: If your hand is empty and the deck has tiles, draw 1 tile now.

ledger_clip.effectText: Gain +1 Gold when entering the shop.

discard_glove.effectText: At each Station start, gain +1 board discard.

mulligan_sleeve.effectText: At each Station start, gain +1 hand discard.

shop_lens.effectText: Item offers in the shop increase by 1.

score_abacus.effectText: The first confirm in each Station gains +30 Chips.

thin_caliper.effectText: Confirms made with 3 or fewer tiles gain +4 Mult.

stage_map.effectText: Clearing a Showdown gives +1 reward Gold.

merchant_stamp.effectText: When entering the shop, the first reroll costs 1 less Gold.

safety_net.effectText: Once per Station, prevent the first combat lock that would end the run.

coin_funnel.effectText: At settlement, each unused board discard gives +1 reward Gold.

hand_funnel.effectText: At settlement, each unused hand discard gives +1 reward Gold.

lucky_counter.effectText: Rare items appear more often in item offers.

echo_bell.effectText: The second confirm in each Station adds 10% of the first confirm score.

boss_trophy.effectText: After clearing a Showdown, the next shop has +1 Jester offer.

thin_wallet.effectText: Use only at 3 Gold or less. Gain +5 Gold.

jester_invoice.effectText: The next Jester purchase costs 4 less Gold.

item_invoice.effectText: The next item purchase costs 4 less Gold.

red_swatch.effectText: On the next confirm, each red tile gives +2 Mult.

blue_swatch.effectText: On the next confirm, each blue tile gives +2 Mult.

black_swatch.effectText: On the next confirm, each black tile gives +2 Mult.

yellow_swatch.effectText: On the next confirm, each yellow tile gives +2 Mult.

rank_chalk.effectText: On the next confirm, each tile sharing a number gives +12 Chips.

deck_needle.effectText: Look at the top 3 deck tiles and discard 1.

tile_polisher.effectText: The first scored tile in each Station gains +20 Chips.

move_token.effectText: Gain +1 board move for this Station.

slide_wax.effectText: The next board move also triggers slide bonus effects.

board_lift.effectText: Reserve +1 board move for the next Station.

undo_seal.effectText: Undo the last board move once.

organizer_glove.effectText: At each Station start, gain +1 board move.

wide_grip.effectText: At each Station start, max hand size +1 and board discard -1.

grand_satchel.effectText: At each Station start, max hand size +2 and hand discard -1.

market_compass.effectText: When entering the shop, discount the cheaper first offer between item and Jester offers by 1 Gold.
